  1. 1

    Why we went from 12 algos to 6

    This was the most common question after the update. The change is by design, and here is the short answer.

    Kept (6)URGOOGXRBOB2XG4MMST
    Retired (6)ARPDDJDRFSAIFSPPLPISYFY
    • Every algo was re-tested on its full history, not just recent months.
    • The six we kept were rebuilt with filters that sit out choppy, sideways days, when the market has no clear direction.
    • In testing on past data (hypothetical), the six had about 20% fewer trades and smaller swings from month to month. Filters also skip some winning trades, so the goal is to skip more losers than winners.
    Expect more days with no trades. With fewer algos, and especially if you run only a few of them, some days will have no trades at all. That is part of the design. If you think something is off, check the no trades checklist or post in your channel.
  2. 2

    How big each algo trades

    Cash and prop firm accounts work differently. Read your column.

    Cash Sizing models

    • Files are named by dollar size, not Low, Medium or High.
    • Stable (Set Size or Fixed) trades the same size every trade.
    • Compounding (Split) trades a share of your balance, so sizes grow and shrink with it. Example: $100,000 and 4 algos is a 25% share each.
    • Minimums (the team's math, your decision): URGO and G4M $10k. OGX, RBO and B2X $15k. MST $20k. IRA 1.5x.
    • Get your exact file from the cash allocator.

    Prop Templates

    • The sizing models do not apply to prop firm accounts.
    • You load a dollar size template instead, and it works like the old risk levels.
    • The $10k template is Low risk. Each bigger template steps up in risk from there.
    Both account types: always load the template in NinjaTrader. Do not test what comes out of the box. Cash video timestamps: choosing a file 16:10, Stable vs Compounding 17:04, allocator 23:11.
  3. 3

    Your steps this week

    Do these in order.

    1. Run the Updater 9.0. Use my earlier Updater 9.0 post in Discord, the links are there.
      Cash: updater and SOPProp: updater and SOP
    2. Back up NinjaTrader once the updater has finished. That gives you a clean starting point to go back to. In the Control Panel click Tools, then Export, then Backup File (badge 1).
    3. Change the auto close time. Click Tools, then Settings (badge 2). Click Trading on the left (badge 3). Under Auto close position, set Time to 03:35:00 PM instead of 04:35:00 PM (badge 4), then click OK.
      The algos close every trade at 3:30 PM ET on their own. This setting is the backup, so it now sits five minutes after.
    ⚠️ Hit a snag on any step? Stop and message in your channel.
